mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, leading to expectations of prolonged monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1300.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 103.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which triggers market expectations of future monetary easing and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 103.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 243.0 and FEDFUNDS above 0.75% signals persistent inflation and a delayed policy response, increasing the risk of stagflation and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 243.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.75%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in UNRATE below 4.5% and rise in PAYEMS above 146,000 thousand signals a labor market overheating, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE < 4.5 and PAYEMS > 146000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in RSAFS above 470,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand and rising inflationary pressures, which leads to expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above 470,000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 103.0 and a concurrent drop in GDPC1 below 16,800 billion dollars signals a contraction in real output and a weakening economy, which triggers market expectations of aggressive monetary easing and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 103.0 and GDPC1 < 16800, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
